title: WSS guide: typing indicator section conflates sender client with receiver client
description: The typing indicator section says 'a client that stops typing and sends typing: false promptly will clear the indicator via the explicit event.' This conflates two different clients: the sender (who signals the server that they stopped typing) and the receiver (who displays the indicator and runs the decay timer). The receiver never sends typing: false — it only receives ChatTypingEvent frames. The section should explicitly name the two roles: the sender signals the server, the server delivers ChatTypingEvent to subscribers, and the decay timer on the receiver side handles the case where the sender crashes without signaling. Should also note that the mechanism by which a client signals typing state to the server is defined outside this spec (in the federation spec or main chat spec), not in the WSS extension.
